mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.folder_id, d.file_id, d.preview_file_id, d.original_preview_file_id, d.index_id, d.org_code, d.dep_id, d.doc_name, d.doc_title, d.serial_number, d.file_type, d.file_size, d.category, d.keywords, d.status, d.fti_flag, d.convert_flag, d.release_flag, d.public_remark, d.current_version, d.download_count, d.comment_count, d.view_count, d.favourite_count, d.process_msg, d.remark, d.create_time, f.folder_name FROM kb_doc d LEFT JOIN kb_folder f ON d.folder_id = f.folder_id AND f.del_flag = '0' WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.doc_id = #{docId}

SELECT d.doc_id, d.folder_id, d.file_id, d.preview_file_id, d.original_preview_file_id, d.index_id, d.org_code, d.dep_id, d.doc_name, d.doc_title, d.serial_number, d.file_type, d.file_size, d.category, d.keywords, d.status, d.fti_flag, d.convert_flag, d.release_flag, d.public_remark, d.current_version, d.download_count, d.comment_count, d.view_count, d.favourite_count, d.process_msg, d.remark, d.create_time, f.folder_name FROM kb_doc d LEFT JOIN kb_folder f ON d.folder_id = f.folder_id AND f.del_flag = '0' WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.folder_id = #{folderId} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.folder_id, COUNT(*) as docCount, SUM(d.file_size) as totalSize, SUM(d.download_count) as totalDownloads, SUM(d.view_count) as totalViews FROM kb_doc d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.folder_id IN ( SELECT folder_id FROM kb_folder WHERE del_flag = '0' AND (folder_id = #{folderId} OR folder_path LIKE CONCAT(#{folderPath}, '%')) ) GROUP BY d.folder_id
